limitations: The first capture was blocked/idle around an OS permission prompt and is excluded from review media. The prompt later cleared; the agent did not act on it.
The observer starts in sandbox and records engine audio and gameplay frames. It does not drive player input, aim, health or ammunition.
The recorder session used a process-only background-audio setting; the normal launch used no such override.
Available native key taps do not establish sustained WASD or held Shift. Eight-direction movement, sprint cancellation and empty/pump edge cases rely on separate frame-spaced production-input tests.
No successful native infected hit or kill was recorded; both the single-infected session and later six-infected encounter killed the stationary player.
Native F6 invocation did not establish populated cleanup. The separate final physicality scenario supplies that evidence.
Audio was captured and numerically measured, but perceptual audition and mix approval were unavailable.
The final approximately95 seconds are silent; this native capture does not establish audible infected attacks or an approved mixed combat soundscape.
Live UI snapshots establish directly observed controls; dense chronological saved-frame review is separately documented in native_motion_review.md.
Window presentation/input and engine-frame capture are separate; private desktop/window metadata and raw logs are excluded from Git.
